mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cancellation_request (request_id, booking_id, reason, requested_by, requested_at, projected_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{bookingId}, #{reason}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE cancellation_request SET decision = #{decision}, discharge_unlocode = #{dischargeUnLocode}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, projected_at = #{projectedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND decision IS NULL
